scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=server & npm run dev --workspace=web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=shared && npm run test --workspace=server
scripts.test:e2e:pg: npm run db:reset && npm run test:e2e:pg --workspace=server
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run db:reset && npm run test:e2e:pg --workspace=server && npm run test:pg --workspace=server
